_doc: Hands for KAYA_BOSSGATE_MODE=sloppy (tests/integration/boss_sloppy_hands.gd). Frames are 1/60 s. 'clean' is the boss's own pen as written, for comparison. 'phone' is the bar every boss is held to: a first-time player on touch controls, reacting 200-333 ms after the thing happens, missing one attack tap in seven, jumping up to 0.1 s late and losing the floating stick under the thumb about once every two seconds. 'careful' is a player on a keyboard. The pen does not adapt its timing to its hands, which a person would; that makes every number here a harsh one, and the same harshness for all five bosses.
